example_summary: Mr. A acquired land through an HUF partition and later sold it. We must determine the cost of acquisition from the previous owner (HUF) and include the holding period to compute the long-term capital gain.
source_provision:
| Statutory Provision | Core Condition / Applicability | Statutory Treatment & Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 49(1)** | Acquisition through specified modes (HUF partition, gift, succession, etc.) | Cost of acquisition shall be the cost for which the previous owner acquired the asset. |
| **Section 2(42A)** | Period of holding in specified previous owner transfers | Period of holding of the previous owner shall also be included for determining long-term or short-term status. |
| **Section 55(1)(b)** | Cost of improvement incurred by the assessee or previous owner | Capital expenditure incurred for additions or alterations is deductible while computing capital gains. |
| **Section 48** | Computation of capital gains on transfer of capital assets | Deduct full value of consideration minus transfer expenses, cost of acquisition, and cost of improvement. |


> [!IMPORTANT] HUF Partition Rule (Section 49(1)(iv)): When a capital asset is distributed upon the total or partial partition of a Hindu Undivided Family, the cost of acquisition is deemed to be the cost to the HUF, and the holding period includes the time the HUF held the asset.


> [!WARNING] Exclusion of Pre-2001 Improvements: For capital assets acquired before 1st April 2001, any cost of improvement incurred prior to 1st April 2001 is ignored, whereas improvements incurred on or after 1st April 2001 are fully allowable.

director.justification: The question requires calculating taxable capital gains by systematically deducting transfer expenses, previous owner's cost of acquisition, and cost of improvement from the sale consideration.
director.visual_metaphor: An escalating ladder of statutory deductions building up to the final taxable capital gains ledger.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Introduce Mr. A, the HUF land acquisition, partition, and final sale in June 2025.
Apply Section 49(1)(iv) to determine the cost of acquisition based on the original HUF purchase price.
Apply Section 2(42A) to include the previous owner's holding period for long-term classification.
Incorporate the cost of improvement under Section 55(1)(b) incurred for fencing.
Compute the final taxable capital gains under Section 48 using all deductions.
Summarize the computation flow for A.Y. 2026-27.

beats.voice_sync_text: നമുക്ക് Mr. A-യുടെ കേസ് നോക്കാം. X & sons എന്ന HUF, P.Y. 2002-03-ൽ 1,20,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് ഒരു സ്ഥലം വാങ്ങി. പിന്നീട് P.Y. 2006-07-ൽ നടന്ന partition-ലൂടെ ഈ സ്ഥലം Mr. A-യ്ക്ക് ലഭിച്ചു. അന്ന് ഇതിന് 1,50,000 രൂപ വിലയുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. ഒടുവിൽ June 2025-ൽ Mr. A ഈ സ്ഥലം 15,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് വിൽക്കുന്നു.
beats.director_goal: Introduce Mr. A, the HUF land acquisition, partition, and final sale in June 2025.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ Section 49(1) പ്രകാരം, HUF partition വഴി ലഭിച്ച asset-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition എന്നത് ആ asset മുൻപ് HUF എത്ര രൂപയ്ക്കാണ് വാങ്ങിയത് അതാണ് എടുക്കേണ്ടത്. അതായത് P.Y. 2002-03-ലെ 1,20,000 രൂപയാണ് നമ്മൾ കണക്കിലെടുക്കേണ്ടത്.

visual_data.rule: Cost to the previous owner is deemed the cost of acquisition for the assessee.
visual_data.application: Cost of 1,20,000 from P.Y. 2002-03 is used instead of partition value.

beats.director_goal: Apply Section 49(1)(iv) to determine the cost of acquisition based on the original HUF purchase price.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 2(42A) പ്രകാരം, asset Long-term ആണോ എന്ന് നോക്കുമ്പോൾ Mr. A കൈവശം വെച്ച കാലയളവ് മാത്രമല്ല, HUF-ന്റെ Holding period കൂടി ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തണം. അതുകൊണ്ട് ഇത് ഒരു Long-term capital asset ആയി കണക്കാക്കാം.
beats.director_goal: Apply Section 2(42A) to include the previous owner's holding period for long-term classification.

beats.voice_sync_text: അടുത്തതായി Section 55(1)(b) പ്രകാരം, Mr. A ആ സ്ഥലത്ത് fencing നിർമ്മിക്കാൻ ചിലവാക്കിയ 2,35,000 രൂപ Cost of improvement ആയി ഡിഡക്റ്റ് ചെയ്യാൻ അനുവദിക്കും.

visual_data.outcome: Allowable Cost of improvement under Section 55(1)(b)

beats.director_goal: Incorporate the cost of improvement under Section 55(1)(b) incurred for fencing.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഇനി നമുക്ക് Section 48 പ്രകാരം Capital Gain കണക്കാക്കാം. Sale consideration ആയ 15,00,000 രൂപയിൽ നിന്ന് 20,000 രൂപ transfer expenses കുറയ്ക്കുന്നു. ശേഷം Cost of acquisition 1,20,000 രൂപയും Cost of improvement 2,35,000 രൂപയും കുറച്ചാൽ നമുക്ക് 11,25,000 രൂപ കിട്ടും.
beats.director_goal: Compute the final taxable capital gains under Section 48 using all deductions.
